name: life-os-cpp
description: Life OS backend: C++20 REST API on Drogon + libpqxx + redis-plus-plus + Kafka, with observability built in
$comment: libsodium and libcurl come from the OS (apt: libsodium-dev, libcurl4-openssl-dev) — vcpkg's libsodium port fails to build on arm64-linux. inja is vendored as a single header in third_party/inja-include (SHA256-asserted in CMakeLists.txt). Both choices keep the docker build green on x86_64 and arm64.
